subject: quantitative_aptitude
question: A caselet outlines the financial metrics of an enterprise: Gross revenue in Year 1 was ₹500 million with an Operating Profit Margin (OPM) of 20%. In Year 2, gross revenue grew by 20%, while direct operating expenses increased by 30% due to supply chain inflation. By what percentage did the absolute operating profit change in Year 2 compared to Year 1?
explanation: Year 1: Revenue R1 = ₹500M. Operating Profit P1 = 20% of 500M = ₹100M. Operating Expenses E1 = Revenue - Profit = 500M - 100M = ₹400M. Year 2: Revenue R2 = 500M × 1.20 = ₹600M. Operating Expenses E2 = 400M × 1.30 = ₹520M. Operating Profit P2 = R2 - E2 = 600M - 520M = ₹80M. Absolute change in profit = 80M - 100M = -₹20M (decrease). Percentage change = (-20 / 100) × 100 = -20% (20% decrease).
